description: Keep only the listed pages of a PDF, in the order given, and return them as a new PDF. Because order follows the spec, it also reorders pages ("3,1,2") and can duplicate them. Use this to pull a section out of a document; use pdf_delete_pages to remove pages instead, pdf_split for several output files, and pdf_merge to join documents. Returns the result inline as an application/pdf resource; the source is never modified. Fails with invalid_pages if a page is out of range.

pages.description: 1-based page spec, e.g. "1-3,5,8-" (open-ended range runs to the last page)

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

name: pdf_extract_pages

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource

title: Extract pages from PDF
